ape-gripping-leafy-stalk.description: A brown ape stands on its hind legs facing right and grips a red stalk with both hands. The stalk carries a red trefoil leaf and a white leaf at the top, a pink leaf at mid height and a rose-red leaf curling at its foot, with a small red bud at the hands of the ape. Dark outlines, white hatching on the fur; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Initial "S" with David in the water below God, who blesses him; ape rides unicorn in margin

ape-gripping-leafy-stalk.title: Ape climbing a leafy stalk
usage_notes: Hung from the upper sprig of foliate-left-and-bottom-margin-border in the source; it stands alone as a figure.

ape-jouster-riding-ram.description: A brown ape rides bareback on a leaping shaggy ram with curled gold horns, facing left. It levels a red lance with a three-pronged tip to the left and holds a pale shield charged with a black lion rampant. The ram's cream fleece is marked with dark curling strokes, and everything is drawn with a black outline. Transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with nimbed apostle and pseudo-inscribed scroll; dragon with man's head and apes jousting in margin

ape-jouster-riding-ram.quality: Figure interior at alpha 251 to 253 rather than 255, invisible in use.
ape-jouster-riding-ram.title: Ape jousting on a ram
usage_notes: Charges to the left; jousting-ape-with-shield-and-lance charges to the right, and the two face each other in the lower margin with the trumpeter beside them.

ape-riding-unicorn-with-hound.description: A brown ape sits astride a grey, shaggy, long-necked mount running to the left and raises a gold sword over its head with both hands; a cream hound behind bites the mount on the rump, where red marks show. The Walters record calls the mount a unicorn; no horn is visible. Dark outlines over grey, tan and cream washes; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Initial "S" with David in the water below God, who blesses him; ape rides unicorn in margin

ape-riding-unicorn-with-hound.title: Ape riding a unicorn, bitten by a hound

apostle-bust-with-scroll.description: Bust of a grey-haired, bearded apostle with an orange-red halo, cut from the initial. He faces slightly to the right, wrapped in a grey-green mantle over an orange-red robe, and holds across his chest a pale scroll bearing a line of pseudo-inscription. Flecks of the gold ground remain along the halo and the right edge, and the right end of the scroll is ragged. Transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with nimbed apostle and pseudo-inscribed scroll; dragon with man's head and apes jousting in margin

apostle-bust-with-scroll.quality: Cut from the initial's gold ground; gold flecks remain along the halo, the hand and the right edge, and the scroll's right end is torn.

blue-and-rose-band-with-gold-pips.description: A long horizontal line filler in two fields between thin white rules: the left third deep blue with three burnished gold discs and a white X cross, the right two thirds dusty rose with white X crosses alternating with small white rings. Dark outline, slightly ragged ends; the background is transparent.

blue-and-rose-band-with-gold-pips.title: Long blue and rose line filler with three gold discs

blue-line-filler-with-white-waves.description: A long blue painted bar pointed at both ends, with two gold roundels at the left end, a white wavy line along the upper half, a row of short white hatch strokes and a long white rule along the lower half, and a curled white terminal at the right. The paint is grainy and the edge of the bar is uneven. Transparent background.

crouching-ape-with-outstretched-hands.description: A brown ape kneels low with its back arched, facing right, both arms stretched forward with open hands. Its belly and rump are pale cream and its head bald, drawn with a heavy black outline and fine white highlights. Transparent background.

crouching-hare.description: A grey-green hare crouches facing left with its long ears laid back along its neck, a dotted line down its spine, its forelegs tucked under and its hind legs bent, and a small round tail at the right. Dark green outline over a pale wash, transparent background.

crowned-bell-ringer-with-hammers.description: A crowned, bearded king in a blue mantle over a rose-brown tunic sits on a cream bench with green arcading and gold leaf finials, turned to the right, and swings two green hammers at four blue bells hung from an orange rod above him. Gold crown, worn gilding on the bells, dark outlines; the background is transparent.

crowned-david-with-book-pointing-to-eye.description: A crowned, bearded King David in a blue robe over a grey-mauve mantle lined with green stands facing left, his right hand raised to point at his eye and his left hand holding a green book. An orange drapery with white dots hangs at the left and grey shoes show below. Gold crown, dark outlines; the background is transparent.

Beneath his feet a blue vine stem with orange and grey-green leaves curls downwards. The right edge of the gown is cut where the page was cropped. Transparent background.

foliate-left-and-bottom-margin-border.description: An L-shaped bar border for the left and bottom margins of a page. A thin blue and gold spine runs down the left, with a cluster of folded blue leaves on a gold ground a third of the way down in which two small animals, one red and one rose, curl in roundels; at the top the stem bends right to a sprig of red and white leaves. Along the bottom a thin brown stem runs right with an orange forked leaf, a gold knot and a dark terminal, broken by gaps; the background is transparent.

foliate-left-and-bottom-margin-border.quality: The bottom stem is broken by gaps where figures overlapped it; the thin stems are soft and the gilding is worn.
foliate-left-and-bottom-margin-border.title: L-shaped margin border, left and bottom
usage_notes: Use as one piece at page scale; it has no repeat and no corner component to compose with.
The gaps in the bottom stem are where margin figures covered it in the source: ape-gripping-leafy-stalk hung from the upper sprig and ape-rider-and-interacting-hounds stood on the bottom stem.

foliate-left-and-top-margin-border.description: An L-shaped margin border running down the left and across the top of the page. At the top-left a bar of blue and burnished gold with serrated gold edges knots into a loop of curling blue leaves and a small brown leaf; from it a thin stem bows down the whole left side and ends in a fork of three leaves in grey-blue, brown and orange, while along the top a slender stem ends in a gold roundel and a brown leaf. Gaps where the initial and figures overlapped it are left open. Transparent background.

foliate-left-and-top-margin-border.quality: Interrupted where the initial and the marginal figures overlapped the border on the page; those gaps are not reconstructed.
foliate-left-and-top-margin-border.title: Blue and gold foliate margin border
usage_notes: Place as a whole page corner with content inside the L; the long left stem and the top stem mark the text-block edges.
The apes, hound and hare of the same folio sit along this border on the page.

foliate-waves-and-gold-roundels-band.description: A long painted bar, blue over its left two thirds and rose-brown over the right third, with a white waving stem carrying small trefoil leaf sprigs along its whole length and four gold roundels set in the blue part near the middle. Edged in dark paint and slightly tapered at the right. Transparent background.

foliate-waves-and-gold-roundels-band.title: Blue and rose line filler with foliate wave and four gold roundels

The left hand points to the left and the right arm cradles a green-banded orb at the right. The lower edge is cut straight where the frame of the initial covered the figure; the background is transparent.

paired-roundels-and-white-waves-band.description: A painted bar, blue over the left half with two gold roundels at its end and rose-brown over the right half, with a white wave and a white dot in each bend running the whole length and a white rule inset along each edge. Uneven edges and grainy paint. Transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with nimbed apostle and pseudo-inscribed scroll; dragon with man's head and apes jousting in margin

paired-roundels-and-white-waves-band.title: Blue and rose line filler with two gold roundels and dotted waves

praying-figure-emerging-from-undulating-.description: A figure rises from a half-disc of green water: the head at the left, tipped back and looking up with closed eyes, the hands joined in prayer above the surface, and the body showing through dark wavy lines of water. The flat top edge of the water is where the frame of the initial met it; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Initial "S" with David in the water below God, who blesses him; ape rides unicorn in margin

praying-figure-emerging-from-undulating-.quality: Cut straight along the upper edge of the water.
praying-figure-emerging-from-undulating-.title: David praying in the water
usage_notes: Pairs with haloed-bust-with-orb-and-raised-hand, the God who blesses him in the same initial; place God above the water.

reclining-green-robed-figure.description: A man in a long grey-green robe and green cap lies stretched out to the right, propped on a cream rectangular object hatched with green bands, and holds up a round cream disc marked with a cross in his left hand; green hose and blue shoes at the right. The top of the head is cut straight at the page edge; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Initial "E" with David ringing bells; apes trapping birds in margin

reclining-green-robed-figure.quality: Cut straight across the top of the head at the page edge; the two held objects are not identifiable.
reclining-green-robed-figure.title: Reclining man in green holding a cross-marked disc

running-collared-hound.description: A grey-brown hound with a long narrow snout, pricked ears and a green collar runs to the left, its forelegs stretched out, its hind legs trailing and its tufted tail raised. Drawn with a heavy black outline over a thin grey-brown wash. Transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with Adoration of the Magi; man combing hair and ape with crossbow in margin

running-collared-hound.title: Running hound with green collar

running-hound-with-curled-tail.description: A pale grey-green hound with a long muzzle, a red nose, folded ears and a green collar runs low to the left, forelegs and hind legs stretched flat and its tail curling up over its back. Dark green outline over a thin wash, transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with nimbed apostle and pseudo-inscribed scroll; dragon with man's head and apes jousting in margin

running-hound-with-curled-tail.title: Low-running hound with green collar

running-spotted-hound.description: A cream hound with black patches and a red collar runs to the right, forelegs stretched forward, hind legs trailing and tail curled up over its back. Dark outline; the body has a grainy, mottled texture; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Initial "D" with an enthroned David pointing to his eye before God; dogs attack unicorn in margins

running-spotted-hound.quality: Grainy, mottled texture over the cream body.
running-spotted-hound.title: Running hound, cream with black patches
usage_notes: Runs toward hound-seizing-long-eared-animal in the same margin chase; place it to the left.

single-roundel-and-looped-wave-band.description: A painted bar, rose-brown over the left third with a single gold roundel at its end and blue over the right two thirds, with a white looped wave running the whole length and a white rule inset along each edge. Uneven ends. Transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with nimbed apostle and pseudo-inscribed scroll; dragon with man's head and apes jousting in margin

single-roundel-and-looped-wave-band.title: Rose and blue line filler with gold roundel and looped wave

standing-ape-archer-with-red-bow-and-lon.description: A grey-brown ape stands upright facing left and draws a long red and black bow, the gold-headed arrow pointing to the left. Its belly and rump are pale and the outline dark green; the feet are slightly ragged along the bottom edge. Transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with Adoration of the Magi; man combing hair and ape with crossbow in margin

standing-ape-archer-with-red-bow-and-lon.title: Ape archer drawing a bow

standing-ape-holding-long-gold-rod.description: A grey-green ape stands upright in profile facing left with its head tilted back, gripping with both raised hands a long gold rod that widens to a flat head at the top right. Its legs are long and bent. The top of the rod and the toes of the rear foot are cut where the margin border and the page crop overlapped them. Dark outline, transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with nimbed apostle and pseudo-inscribed scroll; dragon with man's head and apes jousting in margin

standing-ape-holding-long-gold-rod.quality: The top of the rod and the rear foot are cut where the margin border and the page crop overlapped them.
standing-ape-holding-long-gold-rod.title: Ape raising a gold rod

standing-ape-trumpeter.description: A brown ape stands upright in profile facing left, one hand on its hip, and blows a long straight orange trumpet with a flared bell rimmed in gold, held up to the left. Black outline with fine white highlights, transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with nimbed apostle and pseudo-inscribed scroll; dragon with man's head and apes jousting in margin

standing-ape-trumpeter.quality: Figure interior at alpha 251 to 253 rather than 255, invisible in use.
standing-ape-trumpeter.title: Ape blowing a trumpet
usage_notes: Heralds the two jousting apes of the same margin, ape-jouster-riding-ram and jousting-ape-with-shield-and-lance.

three-roundels-and-white-zigzag-band.description: A long painted bar, blue over the left half with three gold roundels at its end and rose-brown over the right half, with a fine white wavy zigzag running the whole length between a white rule inset along each edge. The bar tapers slightly to the right and its ends are uneven. Transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with nimbed apostle and pseudo-inscribed scroll; dragon with man's head and apes jousting in margin

three-roundels-and-white-zigzag-band.title: Blue and rose line filler with three gold roundels and zigzag

corner-top-left.description: Top-left corner, square at the thickness of the band, composed from the same painted band: the rules turn the angle and one curl sits inside, and its right edge continues into the tile. A modern derivation, not a motif of the page.

white-curled-stroke-pattern-on-blue.description: One cycle of a painted bar border: a white S-curling wave between two thin white rules on a deep blue ground, the pattern continuing across the left and right edges. The top and bottom edges are the ragged painted edges of the band itself, with a dark rim, and everything beyond them is transparent. A matching top-left corner component turns the rules around the angle with one curl inside.

provenance.object_title: Initial “D” with God blessing King David praying before altar; dragon and juggler in margin

white-curled-stroke-pattern-on-blue.quality: Ragged painted top and bottom edges at partial alpha; the blue is mottled and the corner shows faint seams where it was composed.
white-curled-stroke-pattern-on-blue.title: White wave on blue, repeat tile with corner
usage_notes: Repeat along x for a horizontal band, or use the generated rotated tile for a vertical one; the cycle is shorter than the band is thick, so it is a one-motif tile rather than a strip.
The frame atlas composes the tile with the top-left corner mirrored to the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.
